items.title: We Just Got Our First Real Look at AI PCs With Nvidia's RTX Spark 'Superchip'
items.excerpt: At IFA 2026, Nvidia and its partners showed off the first RTX Spark-powered laptops and mini PCs, designed to run AI models right on your computer.
items.note: Anchor story for the on-device-AI beat: the first consumer machines built to run models locally. Directly changes what a designer can run on their own desk without a cloud bill.

items.title: Lenovo just put NVIDIA's Arm superchip in two Yoga laptops, with AI-centric memory configurations
items.excerpt: Lenovo is putting NVIDIA's Arm superchip in a Yoga with up to 128GB of unified memory — enough to run a relatively large LLM entirely on-device, which for regulated firms doubles as a compliance feature.
items.note: The productized version of the Wired RTX Spark story — same silicon, shipping laptop. Overlaps with the WIRED item; curator should pick one.

items.title: Lenovo debuts ThinkCentre X Ultra mini PC with Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495, 128 GB RAM and 131 TOPS
items.excerpt: The Lenovo ThinkCentre X Ultra couples an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 with up to 128 GB of RAM for 131 total TOPS, and four units can be clustered to run very large AI models with over 500 TOPS of compute.
items.note: Desk-side local-inference box: a studio can cluster four for 500+ TOPS instead of renting cloud GPUs.

items.title: Nvidia PAIR utility joins every GPU in your home into a cluster for agentic AI tasks
items.excerpt: Nvidia's Personal AI Router (PAIR) lets agentic AI workloads take advantage of every spare GPU cycle on a home network, promising faster execution and more private inference.
items.note: Software that turns existing hardware into a local agent farm — a real workflow shift for small studios running agent swarms.

items.title: Lenovo ditches fans for solid-state AirJet in a 1.8-pound AeroBlade concept, plus a rollable 14-to-17-inch notebook
items.excerpt: Lenovo's Project Swan puts a 17-inch, 16:9 rollable display inside a 14-inch, 3.5-pound chassis, while the fanless AeroBlade concept uses solid-state AirJet cooling.
items.note: Industrial-design angle: expanding canvas + silent chassis is a direct hardware answer to how creatives want more screen without more bag.

items.title: Ugreen's new smart home ecosystem is built around local AI hubs
items.excerpt: Ugreen has three new HomeAgent hubs that run your smart home with local AI rather than the cloud, with the top model built on Nvidia silicon.
items.note: Ambient computing moving off the cloud — the privacy/latency argument arriving as shipping hardware.

items.title: Anker's New MindBase Home Hub Runs AI Locally, Doubles as NAS
items.excerpt: Anker announced MindBase, an AI home hub for nearly 100 Anker and Matter devices, equipped with an AI Core compute card and the on-device Anker TrueSmart AI, working alongside HomeKit.
items.note: Second data point on the local-AI-hub trend at IFA; overlaps thematically with Ugreen HomeAgent.

items.title: HTC challenges Meta for the US smart glasses market with Vive Eagle
items.excerpt: HTC introduced its Vive Eagle AI smart glasses last summer, and is now finally expanding availability to the US market.
items.note: Smart-glasses category widening beyond Meta. Overlaps with the CNET snap-on battery piece below — same device, different angle.

items.title: These Meta Glasses Alternatives Found a Way to Last Longer With Snap-On Batteries
items.excerpt: HTC's Vive Eagle do a lot of what Meta's glasses do, cameras included, but the snap-on extra battery might be a sign of where Meta and others head next.
items.note: Industrial-design read on the biggest constraint in AI glasses — battery. Duplicate subject with the Android Authority Vive Eagle item.

items.title: This desktop robot companion is also an AI wearable you can wear around your neck
items.excerpt: Lingverse showcased a modular AI wearable at IFA 2026 that switches between a desktop AI companion and a wearable AI pendant.
items.note: Form-factor experiment for the post-phone AI companion — desk object and pendant in one enclosure.

items.title: Flowtica Verso snaps onto your phone with an e-paper display for AI-powered meeting notes
items.excerpt: Flowtica Verso is a $299 MagSafe AI companion with an e-paper touchscreen, a five-mic recording array, and direct meeting insights.
items.note: Accessory-shaped AI device instead of a standalone gadget — a plausible answer to the Humane/Rabbit failure mode.

items.title: Circular's new smart rings add contactless payments and vibrating alerts
items.excerpt: Circular announced the Ring 3 Pro and Ring 3 Slim at IFA 2026, adding NFC contactless payments and haptic alerts to its AI health wearable line.
items.note: Smart rings absorbing phone functions — wearable output moving from screens to haptics.

items.title: Meet the mass-produced humanoid robot that wants to steal your face
items.excerpt: China's UBTECH is launching a line of lifelike humanoid robots that can be customized to resemble designated individuals.
items.note: Character/likeness design as a manufacturing decision — raises the same consent questions designers hit with generative likeness.

items.title: This AI-powered exoskeleton supports your entire lower body — and still fits inside a backpack
items.excerpt: The Hypershell Halo brings full lower-body support and 49% more peak power than the X Ultra, while still packing into a backpack.
items.note: Wearable robotics as a consumer product category — hard industrial-design problem solved in public at IFA.

items.title: I just watched a robot vacuum actually climb stairs — the Roborock Rover
items.excerpt: The Roborock Rover is a stair-climbing robot vacuum, and it actually works — though it takes three minutes per flight and there's a catch.
items.note: Hands-on with the year's most-hyped home-robot mechanism; useful as a reality check on robot capability claims.

items.title: Dyson's New Robot Vacuums Aim at Shark With UV Stain Detection and Powerful Scrubbing
items.excerpt: Dyson's IFA 2026 robot vacuums pair smarter AI perception with UV stain detection and triangular brushes aimed at cleaning floors better.
items.note: AI perception (UV stain sensing) becoming the differentiator in a mature hardware category.

items.title: DJI Romo 2 series brings upgraded suction power and AI capabilities
items.excerpt: DJI unveiled two new robot vacuums, the Romo P2 and Romo A2, following their predecessors' design with the P2 in a transparent shell and the A2 in white.
items.note: DJI's camera/vision stack applied to home robots; transparent-shell industrial design is the visual hook.

items.title: Gemini Spark rolling out Google Photos control for automated editing, sharing and more
items.excerpt: The latest first-party app Gemini Spark can control is Google Photos, with the personal agent able to handle complex, multi-stage editing and sharing workflows.
items.note: On-phone agent now drives a photo editor end to end — the clearest design-workflow hook in today's phone news.

items.title: Perplexity launches privacy-minded 'hybrid compute' AI feature for Mac
items.excerpt: Perplexity's Mac app adds a hybrid compute mode that keeps more processing local, after the company was featured in Apple's M6 Mac mini launch.
items.note: Local-vs-cloud split becoming a product feature on the machine designers actually work on. Carried over as an eligible backup from yesterday.

items.title: iOS 27 beta 8 now available as Apple tests major Siri AI upgrade
items.excerpt: Apple released the eighth iOS 27 developer beta, continuing to test the major Siri AI overhaul ahead of release.
items.note: Apple Intelligence on-device assistant progress; weaker design hook, keep as depth.

items.title: The Best of IFA 2026: AI Dishwashers and Earbuds and Toothbrushes, Oh My!
items.excerpt: Ahead of the IFA 2026 show floor opening, CNET got a sneak peek at the futuristic AI devices on display across the expo.
items.note: Single-card summary option if the curator wants one IFA overview instead of several product items.

items.title: 'You can really unleash a lot of creativity': Philips Hue founder on why its AI upgrades will be genuinely useful
items.excerpt: Philips Hue founder and CTO George Yianni explains why artificial intelligence and home lighting are a fit, and what he is most excited about next.
items.note: A designer/CTO talking about AI as a creative-authoring tool for light — closest thing in gadgets to a craft interview.

items.title: Govee's new ceiling light and LED strips are mood boosters with some AI sprinkled in
items.excerpt: Govee launched several new lighting products at IFA 2026, including a ceiling light that responds to daylight and AI-assisted scene creation.
items.note: Second lighting-AI item; pairs with the Philips Hue interview if the curator wants an ambient-design card.

items.title: Acer C350e Full HD projector debuts with cute design, AI Badge remote control and Google Gemini
items.excerpt: Acer's C350e portable projector arrives with a duckling-yellow design, a rotating and tilting stand, AI-powered Gemini features and 350 ANSI lumens.
items.note: Character-led product design plus an assistant baked into the remote — an unusually design-forward AI device.

items.title: Researchers build a $7 smartphone clip-on that spots hidden cameras with AI
items.excerpt: The $7 clip-on works with a companion AI app by shifting the position of an LED light source to compare reflections and identify hidden camera lenses, hitting 94% accuracy.
items.note: Cheap physical+AI hybrid design; carried over as an eligible backup flagged by yesterday's curator.

items.title: Steam Frame is Getting a Color Passthrough Camera Upgrade Add-on
items.excerpt: The component supplier behind Steam Frame's built-in camera tracking is officially producing a color passthrough module for the headset, which otherwise ships with monochrome passthrough.
items.note: Modular XR hardware — upgradeable sensing instead of a new headset generation.

items.title: Starclash Immersive Animated Experience Out Now On Apple Vision Pro & Quest
items.excerpt: The 33-minute immersive experience Starclash makes you the star of an animated film on Apple Vision Pro and Quest headsets.
items.note: Creative production made for headsets — the content side of the XR device story.

items.title: The Apple Vision Pro was used for a successful hip surgery
items.excerpt: Stryker says its SportSuite Vision software for the Apple Vision Pro received De Novo authorization from the FDA in July, and it has now been used in hip arthroscopy.
items.note: Spatial UI leaving the demo phase for a regulated professional workflow — a serious interaction-design proof point.
